d:
Türkiye and Germany went head-to-head in an unforgettable battle at EuroBasket 2025, with 15 lead changes and 11 ties keeping fans on the edge of their seats!
Alperen Sengun put on a show with 28 points, while Isaac Bonga delivered 20 points for Germany. But when the game came down to the final minutes, Dennis Schroder stepped up with HUGE clutch plays to help Germany secure an 88-83 victory and their second EuroBasket title!
Watch the BEST moments from this incredible EuroBasket 2025 Final!
